title: Independent computational test of SiN–isoprene cyclization products
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and validate multiple constitutional product candidates and mechanistic intermediates rather than evaluate a fixed structure.
Candidate coverage, deduplication, stationary-point validation, and stopping must be justified.

paper.title: Exploring the cyclization reaction channel for the gas-phase elementary reaction between the silicon nitride radical (SiN, X2Σ+) and isoprene (C5H8, X1A′) to prepare methylazasilacyclohexadienylidenes (SiNC5H7, X1A′)

data.description: Self-contained reactant identities, states, formula and experimental boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Validated candidate structures, energies, mechanism evidence, coverage and conclusion.
